about.title: About me
paragraphs: I have been working full time with the web platform since 2011.

I'm currently helping at the amazing {{enac}} @ {{epfl}}, bringing support to researchers throughout their data lifecycle — from building data acquisition pipelines to deploying custom data visualization interfaces.
My last project was at {{prevision}}, helping to scale their AI platform and building an amazing machine learning tool.
Previously I was lead dev at {{numberly}}, shaping their ad-tech products as a dev-ops / full-stack developer.

cv.title: Curriculum Vitae
paragraphs: I graduated from {{epita}} in 2011 from the SCIA master.
I studied Biology and Modelisation at Paris VI between 2011 and 2013 while working part time at the {{memory_foundation}}.

now.title: Now
paragraphs: I'm currently tending tomatoes in my personal garden, modifying a Volkswagen T5 into a better camper van than it already is, and tinkering with my home servers. That's everybody, right?
I'm going to be a dad again soon, so I'm preparing for that too.
